title: Cryptographic Call Behind Internal Helper / Wrapper
description: Tests detection of cryptographic algorithm DES within an internal helper class (LegacyCryptoHelper) and indirect invocation from application logic (DataEncryptor).

expected_findings.evaluation_notes: Scanners must find the direct DES cipher call inside LegacyCryptoHelper. Algorithm is DES with CBC mode and PKCS5Padding. Key size note: key_size_bits = 56 represents the effective cryptographic security strength of DES (derived from the 64-bit encoded key which includes 8 parity bits).

Advanced scanners capable of inter-procedural call-graph analysis should link DataEncryptor to the underlying DES encryption. Basic AST scanners may only detect TC08-F01, which is acceptable for baseline scoring. Key size note: key_size_bits = 56 represents the effective cryptographic security strength of DES (derived from the 64-bit encoded key which includes 8 parity bits).

verification_metadata.verification_method: Manual Source Code Inspection & Call Graph Tracing
